bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Colostrum fade is the clock behind this Peruvian Inca Orchid table, and doses at 8, 12, 16, 16 weeks exist to immunize the puppy while exposure (parks, foster homes, boarding intros) is rising.
Boarding desks ask for finished Peruvian Inca Orchid dates, not intentions, so a Peruvian Inca Orchid with only the first DA2PP / DHPP dose is still incomplete for most facilities.
Dental disease shows up often enough in Peruvian Inca Orchids that vaccine day is also screening day — keep both on the same visit when possible.
Store the rabies label with the Peruvian Inca Orchid profile immediately; lost paperwork is the most common reason Peruvian Inca Orchid travel and kennel check-ins stall.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Peruvian Inca Orchid shots when the puppy seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or dental disease worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Peruvian Inca Orchid make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Peruvian Inca Orchid antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Peruvian Inca Orchid dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this medium dog.
Reset the Peruvian Inca Orchid reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Peruvian Inca Orchid core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Peruvian Inca Orchid misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Peruvian Inca Orchid health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Peruvian Inca Orchid adult health guide for breed predispositions such as dental disease, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
